start: A member on a new phone with a MettleUp backup in Google Drive, welcome screen

steps.action: Tap 'Try another way', then 'Continue with Google'; tick the 18+ and terms box
must_not: Google opened before the box is ticked

user_sees: 'Checking your Google Drive for a backup…'
'We found your backup from 3 Nov 2026 with 120 workouts. Bring it back to this phone?'
must_not: A workout count that does not match the backup

user_sees: The app opens with the workouts back
must_not: The welcome left held with a spinning button
An older backup restored than the one offered

start: A gym member whose phone is linked to a gym (server copy), welcome screen

steps.action: Tap 'Continue with Google' and pick the account
must_not: A Drive search instead of the gym's copy

user_sees: The 3 setup questions with the name filled

start: A member with no MettleUp backup in Drive

steps.action: Tap 'Continue with Google' without ticking the box
user_sees: A message to tick the 18+ and terms box
'No MettleUp backup in your Google Drive yet. Tap Next to set up the app.'

must_not: An error message for a cancel

start: A member with 5 workouts on the phone (kept after removing the demo)

steps.action: Find the backup, tap 'Restore my backup'
user_sees: 'The 5 workouts on this phone are deleted and your backup takes their place.'

steps.action: Tap 'Replace' with a backup that has no profile
user_sees: 'Your workouts are back. Tap Next and add your name to carry on.'

steps.action: Tap 'Not now' on a found backup

start: A member signing in with Google

user_sees: Only the MettleUp backup file is read
must_not: Other Drive files read or listed
Drive used for anything but bringing back the backup
